notes: HIGH-VALUE DETAIL: this is the first image in this batch that names the VENUE. The chart subtitle reads 'Bitcoin/USD Tether Perpetual Contract · 2h · BingX...' - so the BTC charts (including the fully-drawn one in IMG_7807, which carries the identical level tags 82,490.4 / 80,905.2 / 74,939.5 / 74,617.4 / 74,617.0) are BingX BTCUSDT perpetual on a 2h timeframe. The crosshair readout also fixes the chart timezone as UTC+5:30 and the snapshot time as Mar 18, 2026 20:27 - note this is ~2.5h BEFORE the 22:59 message it is attached to. Chat text is fully legible (high confidence); the chart is NOT - only its top sliver is above the screen edge, showing empty air above the price, one lone candle and the upper part of the freehand up arrow, so no last price, time axis or trade structure could be read and those fields are null. 80,000.0 and 78,000.0 are plain grey axis gridlines and are deliberately EXCLUDED from drawn_levels. The ' ... ' in 'Finest trade fr ... but had to buy a watch' is Ace's own ellipsis, not app truncation - the message continues on the next line. Both 'Ace Current thoughts about BTC 🤴 [image]' lines are reply previews quoting his earlier 17/03 18:24 post (the IMG_7807 chart), not new statements, so they are in the transcript but not in 'statements'. The first two lines are a repeat of the end of IMG_7808 (consecutive scroll). FACTUAL ODDITY worth flagging for the later analysis, recorded verbatim without correction: on 18 March he writes 'This month is so crucial - Starting of Q2' - March is Q1, not the start of Q2. Also note the sequence 17/03 19:37 'going to buy a watch' -> 18/03 19:46 'but had to buy a watch so i exit', i.e. the watch purchase is repeatedly given as the exit rationale. Spelling/grammar left verbatim ('how excited I'm').
